name: Airborne and Special Operations Museum
unique: A museum of airborne and special operations warfare with a simulated parachute drop, a C-47, a jeep wall and the stories of the soldiers who used them, next to Fort Bragg.
buzz: Free and very well done, with enough noise and motion for kids and enough detail for adults. Allow two hours.

name: Cape Fear Botanical Garden
unique: Eighty five acres of gardens on the Cape Fear River bluff, with a camellia collection, a children's garden and trails through longleaf pine.
buzz: The river bluff and the camellias in winter are the quiet wins. Good with kids because of the play garden.

name: Fayetteville Market House
unique: An 1832 market house on the site of the 1789 ratification convention, where North Carolina joined the Union, now a landmark in the middle of downtown.
buzz: The building is the photo and the history plaque is the story. A quick stop on the downtown walk.

name: Carvers Creek State Park
unique: A new state park around a 1930s Rockefeller estate, with longleaf pine restoration, a millpond and trails past the old farm buildings.
buzz: Quiet and flat, with good birding and a sense of an old estate. Free and rarely crowded.

name: Raeford Historic District
unique: A small courthouse square with brick storefronts and a railroad crossing, in a Sandhills town built on turpentine, cotton and the military nearby.
buzz: A quick leg stretch with a couple of good lunch spots. The courthouse is the anchor.

name: Lumber River State Park
unique: A blackwater river with sandbars, cypress and tupelo, protected as a state park and a national wild and scenic river, with canoe access and camping.
buzz: The water is dark and the current is gentle, good for a first overnight paddle. Bring a map and bug spray.

name: Laurinburg Historic District
unique: A grid of Victorian houses, churches and a courthouse around a small commercial core, in a town shaped by the railroad and the Carolina Central railway shops.
buzz: Quiet and well kept, with a good diner downtown. The old depot is the photo.

name: Scotland County Courthouse
unique: A neoclassical courthouse with columns and a clock, on a square of old storefronts in the Sandhills.
buzz: A quick architectural stop. Pair it with the historic district walk.

name: Museum of the Native American
unique: A resource center and museum at UNC Pembroke with Lumbee history, powwow regalia, pottery and the story of a tribe recognized by the state but not the federal government.
buzz: Personal and specific, with staff who are part of the community. Free, but check the hours.

name: Lumberton Riverwalk
unique: A boardwalk and trail along the Lumber River through downtown, with cypress trees, turtles and a view of the river that floods the town.
buzz: Flat and shady, good for a morning walk. The river is the town's defining feature and its recurring problem.

name: Hopkins Park
unique: A large city park on the Lumber with a lake, a walking trail, a splash pad and disc golf, plus a nature trail through bottomland forest.
buzz: The splash pad and playground are the family draw. Quiet on weekdays.

name: Jones Lake State Park
unique: A Carolina bay lake with a white sand shore and tea colored water, ringed by bay forest and a CCC era picnic area, one of the strangest ecosystems in the state.
buzz: The beach is sandy and the water is warm and dark. The bay forest trail explains why the lake is oval and facing the same way as others.

name: Harmony Hall Plantation
unique: A 1760s plantation house on a bluff over the Cape Fear, with original outbuildings and a view of the river that carried the rice and naval stores trade.
buzz: The house is small and the setting is the star. Check the hours, which are limited.

name: Bladen County Courthouse
unique: A courthouse on a small square in a town that was once a revolutionary crossroads, with a Confederate monument and old storefronts.
buzz: A quick stop on the way to Jones Lake. The square is quiet.

name: Lake Waccamaw State Park
unique: A 9,000 acre Carolina bay lake with clear water, a white sand bottom and a swimming beach, surrounded by pine and cypress.
buzz: The water is unusually clear for a bay lake and the beach is shallow. Good for kids and a picnic.

name: North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences at Whiteville
unique: A small satellite of the Raleigh natural sciences museum with live animals, a discovery gallery and exhibits on the longleaf pine ecosystem.
buzz: Free and good for an hour with kids, especially on a rainy beach day.

name: Columbus County Courthouse
unique: A neoclassical courthouse on a wide main street with a fountain, in the county that calls itself the home of the Carolina bay.
buzz: The downtown is small but well kept. Pair it with the museum.

name: Moores Creek National Battlefield
unique: The site of a 1776 Patriot victory that ended British authority in North Carolina, with earthworks, a bridge reconstruction and a cypress swamp trail.
buzz: The story is a surprise to most visitors and the trail is easy. Free, with a small museum.

name: Topsail Beach
unique: A quiet barrier island beach at the southern end of Topsail, with a pier, sea turtle nests and a sound side for kayaking.
buzz: Much calmer than the northern beach towns. Parking is limited, so go early.

name: Burgaw Historic District
unique: A main street of brick storefronts, a courthouse and a depot, with the old jail and a blueberry festival that fills the town in June.
buzz: The blueberry festival is the local event, and the street is a pleasant walk the rest of the year.

name: Duplin Winery
unique: The largest muscadine winery in the country, with tastings, a bistro, live music and a gift shop, in a county where the grape is a point of pride.
buzz: The sweet wines are the style and the tasting is generous. Book the bistro for lunch on weekends.

name: Liberty Hall
unique: A 1790s plantation house with original outbuildings, a boxwood garden and the story of the Kenan family, in a small town named for them.
buzz: The house tour is personal and the grounds are quiet. Check hours before driving out.

name: Clinton Historic District
unique: A courthouse square with a 1900s courthouse, brick storefronts and a railroad, in the county that calls itself the land of the long leaf pine.
buzz: Small and quiet, with a good lunch counter. The square is the walk.

name: Sampson County History Museum
unique: A county museum with farm tools, a one room school and military exhibits, in a former church near downtown Clinton.
buzz: Volunteer run and free, with the kind of local detail big museums skip. Call first.
